data.title: Trump's Name Can't Be Reinstalled on Kennedy Center, Judge Rules — WSJ
data.description:
By Lydia Wheeler

A federal judge has blocked President Trump's name from immediately going back on the front of the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts, the latest twist in the continuing legal saga over the president's attempts to overhaul the cultural institution in the nation's capital.

Judge Christopher Cooper in Washington, D.C., on Tuesday denied the latest attempt by the venue's board to affix an inscription that says "renovated and restored by Donald J. Trump" under President John F. Kennedy's name on the front portico and prohibited it from renaming the grounds of the center after Trump.

Cooper said the renaming violates the order he issued in May, which required Trump's name to be removed from the building-where the board, stacked with the president's appointees, had voted to add it. Only Congress has the authority to rename the institution, he ruled at the time.

While Cooper said in Tuesday's decision that he appreciated how major supporters of cultural institutions are routinely recognized with prominent inscriptions on buildings and in other public areas, "Congress had other ideas for the Kennedy Center."

"It limited such memorials and donor recognitions to discrete (and discreet) areas, so as not to detract from the Center's function as an ongoing memorial to President Kennedy," he said.

Cooper, an Obama appointee, said he wouldn't decide now if the board can lawfully add a second inscription in the future-which would say "endowed by The Trump Kennedy Center Fund"-because the board said that won't be added until the private endowment it created in June has raised $100 million.

"The Fund has raised nothing yet," Cooper said. He directed the board to notify him when the endowment has raised the money and give the court at least 60 day's notice before it installs an inscription.

The judge's decision comes ahead of a planned meeting in which the center's board is expected to vote on a new resolution to immediately close the center's main building for two years for renovations. Trump said in a social-media post earlier Tuesday that the building is in such bad shape that people could be hurt if it is kept open.

Write to Lydia Wheeler at lydia.wheeler@wsj.com

data.title: Datavault AI Receives Initial $100 Million Purchase Order for $QEST Tokenization Services
data.description:
Datavault AI Inc. (“Datavault AI” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: DVLT), a provider of data monetization, credentialing, digital engagement, and real-world asset (“RWA”) tokenization technologies, today announced that it has received an initial purchase order for $100 million of its $QEST tokenization services. The purchase order marks the commercial opening of the Company’s Information Data Exchange® (“IDE®”), NILvault™ (“NILv”) and American Political Exchange™ (“APEX™”) platforms. The three platforms are designed to let institutions and rights holders value, prove, list, settle and hold data and other RWAs on a single rail, using the Company’s patented Data Vault® architecture together with its DataValue® and DataScore® scoring and valuation engines and the NYIAX matching and settlement stack acquired on August 18, 2026.

The opening coincides with Roberto Clemente Day across Major League Baseball. Datavault AI is using the data to introduce a working name, image, and likeness use case to market: an operating marketplace for rights that already exist.

Information Data Exchange: The Listing Layer for $QEST

IDE® is Datavault AI’s patented marketplace for the secure valuation, scoring, tokenization, and monetization of data and real-world assets. DataScore® assesses quality and attributes. DataValue® establishes economic value. The architecture is designed to perform that work without moving, ingesting, storing, or altering a customer’s original dataset, creating authenticated digital twins and immutable metadata objects at the point of origin.

$QEST utility tokens, representing access and usage rights to Available Infrastructure’s Project Qestrel nationwide edge-AI fleet, are among the first compute assets the Company intends to list on IDE®. As previously disclosed, the tokenized value of the Project Qestrel program is expected to contribute to our 2026 and 2027 revenue. The company continues to reaffirm $200 million in fiscal revenue in 2026.

IDE® is also designed to support additional real-world asset categories the Company has been developing across licensed verticals, including catalogue and royalty interests in recorded music, film and media libraries, computer-generated likeness and CGI rights, mass-tort and legal-settlement claims data, and original comedic material previously demonstrated as Joke Token. These categories remain subject to applicable securities, commodities, and intellectual property law. A listing is not a sale. Conversion of contracted opportunity into recognized revenue is the operating metric from this date forward.

NILvault: Name, Image and Likeness, Beginning with Baseball

NILvault™ applies Data Vault®, DataValue®, DataScore® and IDE® digital-twin infrastructure to name, image and likeness rights so that an athlete or an estate can establish, value, license and audit what a name actually earns. The problem in sports is not discovery. It is provenance: who owns the likeness, who licensed it, what it is worth, and whether the receipt survives review.

Datavault AI’s first baseball proof point was June 26, 2026, a partnership with 21 In Right Inc., the Clemente family entity that owns and manages the name, image, and likeness of Baseball Hall of Famer Roberto Clemente. Under that agreement, 21 In Right is using the Company’s platforms to protect Clemente’s rights, preserve the legacy through digital twins and digital archives, and develop fan-engagement assets, including Clemente-themed digital collectibles contemplated for the Philadelphia activation announced with the partnership. Opening NILvault™ on Roberto Clemente Day is the commercial expression of that work: a vaulted likeness with an audit trail.

Related MLB Network coverage of the Clemente legacy includes Harold Reynolds’s conversation with Roberto Clemente Jr. and Reynolds’s on-air conversation with Luis and Roberto Clemente Jr. Those broadcasts are cited as public record of the Roberto Clemente Day platform and not as an endorsement of the Company.

American Political Exchange: Campaign Data on an Auditable Rail

American Political Exchange™ is designed to bring auditability to political data, advertising inventory, and related information assets without asking a committee to leave a controlled rail. Campaign finance compliance does not fail for lack of slogans. It fails when identity is verified, and the action taken on the data is not; when an advertisement is bought, and the receipt cannot survive an examination; and when a contribution path cannot be reconstructed. APEX™ applies the same DataValue®, DataScore® and IDE® stack to constituent and campaign-intelligence data and seats NYIAX matching under the listing.

The commercial predicate is not a new theory of election law. It is two unanimous Federal Election Commission advisory opinions issued to DataVault Holdings, Inc. on December 15, 2022: Advisory Opinion 2022-22, permitting the sale of digital tokens to political committees in the ordinary course of business, at the normal charge and on the same terms as non-political clients, and Advisory Opinion 2022-23, permitting the licensing of patented ADIO® inaudible-tone technology to political committees on the same ordinary-course terms. APEX™ is designed to operate inside those opinions and inside applicable federal and state requirements. It does not replace the Federal Election Campaign Act. It is designed to give a committee a receipt that an examination can read.

NYIAX: The Matching Engine Under the Listing

Tokenization without a market is a certificate. NYIAX, which was acquired by Datavault AI on August 18, 2026, is the matching engine. Built first as an institutional marketplace for guaranteed advertising inventory, NYIAX demonstrated that a media contract that once lived in a spreadsheet could be standardized, priced, matched, transferred, and settled on a blockchain rail using financial-market principles. Four issued U.S. patents cover trading, matching, transfer, settlement and the lifecycle of variable inventories. Collective Audience’s commercialization layer folded in with the close. NYIAX does not invent the asset. It turns a match into an auditable transfer. Across IDE®, NILvault™ and APEX™, the same engine is now asset-agnostic, spanning advertising inventory, attested data, name, image and likeness rights, campaign records, mineral offtake and catalogue rights.

“Our objective has never been simply to create a token,” said Nathaniel T. Bradley, CEO of Datavault AI. “We are building infrastructure designed to identify an asset, authenticate it, establish its value, tokenize it and create a pathway to monetize it. NYIAX adds institutional-grade market infrastructure designed around matching, price discovery, contracting, transactions and settlement. Tokenization by itself does not create a market.”

About Datavault AI

Datavault AI™ (NASDAQ: DVLT) is leading the way in AI-driven data experiences, valuation, and monetization of assets in the Web 3.0 environment. The Company’s cloud-based platform provides comprehensive solutions with a collaborative focus in its Acoustic Sciences and Data Sciences divisions.

Datavault AI’s Acoustic Sciences division features WiSA®, ADIO®, and Sumerian® patented technologies and industry-first foundational spatial and multichannel wireless, high-definition sound transmission technologies with intellectual property covering audio timing, synchronization, and multi-channel interference cancellation. The Data Science division leverages the power of Web 3.0 and high-performance computing to provide solutions for experiential data perception, valuation, and secure monetization.

Datavault AI’s platform serves multiple industries, including high-performance computing software licensing for sports & entertainment, events & venues, biotech, education, fintech, real estate, healthcare, energy, and more. The Information Data Exchange® enables Digital Twins and the licensing of name, image, and likeness by securely attaching physical real-world objects to immutable metadata, fostering responsible AI with integrity. The Company’s technology suite is fully customizable and offers AI- and machine-learning-based automation, third-party integration, detailed analytics and data, marketing automation, and advertising monitoring.

The Company is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA. Learn more about Datavault AI at https://dvlt.ai.

data.title: Top stocks in focus tomorrow: Investors must watch NBCC, BHEL, Bharat Forge shares on Wed, 16 Sept | Triggers
data.description:
New Delhi, Sept. 15 -- Indian stock market investors are likely to track several companies on Wednesday, September 16, following key business developments, order wins, manufacturing updates, regulatory developments and other corporate announcements.

Tata Communications, RR Kabel, Aurobindo Pharma, Bharat Forge and Saatvik Green Energy are among the stocks likely to remain in focus. GTPL Hathway, BHEL, Purple Style Labs and NBCC (India) may also attract attention followiney announcements made by the companies.

Tata Communications: Tata Communications said its subsidiary TC Canada and the Canada Revenue Agency have reached an in-principle agreement to settle tax claims related to its International Telecommunications Services business. The company said no material impact on its financials is currently expected from the settlement.

Separately, the company said that it issued Rs.400 crore of commercial paper at a 5.99% discount rate, with redemption due on October 22.

RR Kabel: RR Kabel has commenced commercial production of its new wires and cables manufacturing unit in Silvassa on September 15. The facility has a planned annual capacity of 18,000 MT, with 12,000 MT currently operational.

Aurobindo Pharma: Aurobindo Pharma said the USFDA inspection of its wholly owned subsidiary Apitoria Pharma's API manufacturing facility in Telangana concluded with one procedural observation. The company said it will respond to the regulator within the stipulated timeline.

Bharat Forge: Bharat Forge has partnered with Pratt & Whitney Canada to evaluate the integration of advanced turboprop engines into a HALE UAV programme being developed by India's DRDO. The collaboration covers engine compatibility and engine-airframe integration.

Saatvik Green Energy: Saatvik Green Energy has secured an order worth Rs.1,041.63 crore from Solar Energy Corporation of India for the supply of solar PV modules, with completion scheduled by December 2027.

GTPL Hathway: GTPL Hathway has completed the acquisition of the cable television business of seven ACT Group companies for an aggregate cash consideration of Rs.35.55 crore.

BHEL: BHEL has signed a joint venture agreement with Titagarh Rail Systems to form a 50:50 joint venture for the maintenance of Vande Bharat sleeper trainsets for 35 years.

Purple Style Labs: Purple Style Labs has approved a Rs.420 crore investment in its wholly owned subsidiary PSL Retail through a rights issue, using part of the proceeds from its IPO fresh issue.

NBCC (India): NBCC has received work orders worth Rs.144.98 crore, including project management services for NEEPCO and repair-related work for SAIL.

data.title: Embassy Developments to double down on luxury housing, says MD Aditya Virwani
data.description:
Bengaluru, Sept. 15 -- Embassy Developments Ltd (EDL), the residential development arm of Embassy Group, plans to renew its focus on premium and luxury projects, given the high demand from homebuyers, investors and non-resident Indians amid limited supply, managing director Aditya Virwani said in an interview.

In 2025-26, 125 residential units priced at over Rs.10 crore were sold in Bengaluru, totaling Rs.2,087 crore, compared to 84 similarly priced units sold in FY25, according to a recent Southern Indian High End Luxury Housing Report by CRE Matrix and Sotheby's International Realty. Embassy projects accounted for over 60% of the sales in Bengaluru in this price segment.

Hyderabad, however, remained the market leader in this segment, with 645 units sold for Rs.8,562 crore, while Chennai was the smallest of the three, with 58 units sold for Rs.727 crore.

"Bengaluru has a lot of scope to do more but supply is limited. This is why we want to double down on ultra-luxury housing. We want to be a brand known for luxury but also want to hit volumes with premium projects. Our definition of premium is typically an entry price of Rs.2 crore in an Embassy project," Virwani said.

This week, EDL is launching the first phase of an 85-acre development in north Bengaluru with Rs.4,500 crore of gross development value (GDV). One of the two projects to be launched has 217 villas with a starting price of Rs.14 crore. The second project has apartments priced at Rs.2 crore and above. It will launch another premium residential tower, named Embassy One, with 59 units in the city.

EDL has a sales booking target of Rs.8,000 crore in FY27, supported by a robust Rs.19,500-crore launch pipeline. It has already launched inventory worth Rs.9,000 crore.

In FY26, the developer reported around Rs.4,631 crore of sales bookings. It expects Bengaluru to continue to lead, even as Mumbai steadily gains traction. "South India's luxury housing market has reached a pivotal inflection point.

Hyderabad has emerged as the undisputed leader. Bengaluru is in the midst of a defining transformation with new corridors, proving that premium living is no longer confined to legacy addresses. Chennai, though smaller in scale, holds its own as a prestige-driven market with a distinctly niche buyer profile," said Abhishek Kiran Gupta, co-founder and CEO, CRE Matrix.

EDL has lined up luxury projects in Mumbai, too. It recently launched a two-acre project with just 38 units, around 6,000 sq ft each, in the city's upmarket Juhu locality. The price per sq ft is above Rs.1 lakh.

The developer entered south Mumbai through its 'Citadel' project in Worli, with apartments priced at Rs.15 crore and up. "We think the project is a good value proposition in the Worli micromarket. At a later stage, when construction gains pace, we can go a little aggressive with pricing," Virwani added. It will also launch a project in Alibaug, near Mumbai, which has gained a lot of attention as an extended premium housing address.

Interest from NRIs has also been on the rise, said Reeza Sebastian Karimpanal, chief revenue officer, residential, at EDL. NRIs previously accounted for 6-8% of its sales, but since the West Asia war this has increased to 8-10%, she said.

EDL will also launch a commercial office project in Gurugram this year. Bengaluru-based Embassy Group is the sponsor of the Embassy Office Parks REIT and promoter of shared workspace operator WeWork India. data.title: Bank CEOs: Consumers Are Spending, Including on Movies and Cruises — WSJ
data.description:
By Ben Glickman

It's all systems go for the American consumer, say bank executives, including strong spending on travel and entertainment.

  • "There is still quite strong spending across the board, and it has just not been changing really at all," said Wells Fargo CFO Mike Santomassimo at an investor conference. "You couple that with really good credit performance."
  • "The much rumored post-Covid wall that the consumer was going to hit didn't happen," said PNC Financial Services President Mark Wiedman.
  • Part of the spending growth is from higher gas prices, but discretionary spending is still strong, said Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan. He shouted out cruise bookings, restaurants and out-of-home entertainment: "The movies have come back because they've had some good movies."

This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).

data.title: Revolut wins Colombia bank license, targeting 2027 launch
data.description:
By Nelson Bocanegra

British fintech Revolut said on Tuesday it had obtained a banking license in Colombia, according to a company statement.

The company plans to start operations in the South American country in 2027, a source told Reuters.

Revolut said it would invest an additional $62 million in Colombia in digital banking infrastructure and financial technology, doubling its initial investment.

The license, granted by Colombia's banking authorities, was the final regulatory step required before launch, the company said.

Revolut said it has more than 80 million customers globally, and nearly 200,000 Colombians on a waiting list to join.

data.title: Nvidia, Coinbase, Skyworks, Axon, Tesla, Applied Aerospace, and More Stocks That Explain Today's Market — Barrons.com
data.description:
By George Glover and Mariapaula Gonzalez

Stocks fell Tuesday as the 10-Year Treasury yield reached its highest level in 19 years and investor fears over the selloff in artificial-intelligence stocks Monday began to ease.

Chip and memory stocks edged higher, having taken a battering on Monday after several top executives called for a slowdown in AI development. Coherent, Intel, Lumentum, Micron, and Sandisk rose.

Nvidia advanced 1.1%. CEO Jensen Huang pushed back on the AI doomsday sentiments, with President Donald Trump on his side. The two spoke on the phone on stage at the All-In Summit in Los Angeles, Calif., where Trump called limitations on AI development a "hoax" and Huang said that "everybody wins in the AI race in America."

Tesla gained 0.8%. CEO Elon Musk recently teased a potential merger between Tesla and SpaceX on an All-In Podcast episode featuring SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell. Musk also hyped up Tesla's second-generation Roadster, an electric sports car that will launch Oct. 1.

Shares of software developers struggled as investors locked in some profits following the previous session's rally. Palantir and Workday slipped 0.6% and 0.7%, respectively. CrowdStrike rose 0.2%.

Crypto exchange Coinbase dropped 6.3%, trading platform Robinhood declined 4.6%, and Bitcoin investor Strategy fell 4.9% as hopes of the Clarity Act passing this year faded. The Senate is set to vote on the crypto regulation bill later Tuesday.

Enova International tanked 24%. The financial services company said it has withdrawn regulatory applications for its proposed acquisition of digital bank Grasshopper Bancorp. Enova, however, reaffirmed its fiscal 2026 and fiscal third-quarter earnings guidance.

Etsy rose 1.1% to $75.19. Oppenheimer upgraded Etsy to Outperform from Perform, citing that artificial intelligence for online shopping search will likely boost the stock. Oppenheimer also set a $90 price target.

Shares of energy majors rose as benchmark oil prices rallied. Halliburton added 0.6% and Occidental Petroleum climbed 2.3%.

data.title: Analysts See Weekly Decline in U.S. Crude Oil Stockpiles
data.description:
By Anthony Harrup

U.S. crude oil inventories likely posted a third consecutive withdrawal last week as refineries continue running at high capacity, according to a survey by The Wall Street Journal.

Commercial crude stocks are seen falling by 1.4 million barrels to 422.7 million barrels in the week ended Sept. 11, according to the average estimate of seven analysts and traders. Expectations range from a decline of 568,000 barrels to a drop of 2 million barrels.

Gasoline inventories are expected to be down by 800,000 barrels at 206.1 million barrels, with estimates ranging from a 1 million barrel increase to a 1.5 million barrel decline.

Stocks of distillate fuel, mostly diesel, are seen unchanged at 106.3 million barrels. Forecasts range from a 1 million barrel increase to a decline of 1.7 million barrels.

Refinery capacity is forecast to have eased by 0.6 of a percentage point to 97.2%, with estimates ranging from unchanged to a decline of 2 percentage points. One analyst didn't forecast refinery runs.

data.title: US Treasury's Bessent says bond yields reflect 'global issues'
data.description:
Key points:
  • 10-year Treasury yield hits 5.041%, highest since 2007
  • Bessent says he will meet Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng this weekend
  • Treasury buybacks were a success, Bessent says, pointing to debt auctions

By David Lawder

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Tuesday blamed rising bond yields on "global issues" and confirmed he will meet with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng this weekend ahead of a meeting between President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping next week.

Bessent told a hearing of the House Financial Services Committee that Trump and Xi would continue discussions on Iran and China's financial links to Tehran, which Washington has been seeking to shut out of Western financial systems as the war with Iran stretches into its seventh month.

The hearing was nominally on the international finance system, including reforms to the International Monetary Fund and World Bank, but lawmakers peppered Bessent with questions about a variety of more pressing issues, like the state of financial markets and the economy, and the administration's punitive financial measures against Iran.

As the hearing got underway, several protesters stood up one after another to call for an end to sanctions on Iran and the war, forcing Bessent to stop and restart his opening statement. The people were hustled from the room.

Bessent told reporters rising bond yields were due to "global issues," as he headed into the hearing. The U.S. 10-year Treasury yields on Tuesday hit peaks not seen since 2007 amid a global bond rout experienced by most other large economies.

Analysts tie the U.S. bond yield increase to higher oil prices and expectations the Federal Reserve will raise its policy rate this week, as well as competition for capital from AI spending and concerns about the U.S. fiscal trajectory.

During the hearing Bessent acknowledged the rise in the 10-year yield reflects "the need to address the deficit," among other things.

U.S. bond yields have risen despite recent Treasury buybacks of longer-term debt that Bessent has described as a way to inject liquidity and to counter the rise in yields, or at least slow it down.

Bessent told lawmakers the buybacks were a success and underscored U.S. credibility.

"There is a counterfactual of what would it have done — and we then proceeded to have the two most successful Treasury auctions that we've had in 20 years," Bessent told the congressional hearing. "Since President Trump has come in, (the U.S. bond market) has been the best-performing bond market in the developed world."

He also defended the Treasury's joint intervention with Japan to shore up its currency, saying the U.S. did it to signal support for Japanese policies.

Several Democratic lawmakers pressed Bessent on the state of the economy and rising inflation — tying it to the Iran war and the run-up in global oil prices. Bessent blamed inflation on the Biden administration, and insisted Americans are better off under Trump.

He was also asked if Trump's proposal to pay each American $5,000 if Trump's Republican party maintains congressional majorities in the November election was a serious one. He said he would work with House Speaker Mike Johnson to make those payments happen if congressional approval proved to be needed.

Bessent said the U.S. dollar's strength reflects the Trump administration's credibility.

"A strong dollar is not a price on a screen; it is a set of behaviors, and what we have seen in this administration, where we are creating regulatory certainty, tax certainty, trade certainty and energy certainty that is bringing in trillions of dollars into the U.S.," Bessent said.
